item.title: Stocks End Their Losing Streak as Investors Look Past Nvidia Turmoil
item.description: The S&P 500 rose 2.5% for the week, snapping four straight weekly declines. All 11 sectors finished higher. Investors are now focused on Nvidia's earnings and Anthropic's IPO next week.

item.title: Anthropic Lines Up Meetings With Investors Ahead of Blockbuster Listing
item.description: Anthropic plans to sell about 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each. The listing, expected the week of Nov. 16, could value the company at up to $1.4 trillion.
